# billie.mcp

> Billie Cavallaro is a principal product designer in Chicago focused on agentic AI and design systems. This site hosts billie.mcp, a Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents learn about his work, check his fit for a role, request his case studies, book an intro, and find his digital products for designers.

## Connect

- Install (Claude Code): claude mcp add billie -- npx -y github:Billiecavallaro/AI-Design
- Install (any MCP app, stdio): npx -y github:Billiecavallaro/AI-Design
- Tools: get_profile, get_fit_for_role, list_case_studies, get_case_study, request_full_access, book_intro, list_products, get_product
- Resource: billie://profile

## About Billie

- Designed and shipped Fuse Assist, Capital One's first AI risk product, from concept to production.
- At Discover, unified seven internal risk products on a shared design system and contributed components back to it.
- Co-founded Prompts and Pixels, an internal AI community at Capital One.
- Founded Space Shake, a keto shake brand that grew to $5.2M and closed deals on Shark Tank.
